approach: Scope: the metaphor-free mechanism in packages/cyberlegion only. A standing record gains an optional home + launch recipe; the delivery doorbell spawns a presence into that home when none is live, binding it under the existing presence lock.

Expected additive-only on two frozen suites (unit/registry, mail/doorbell): new scenarios carve a narrower Given (an owner with a recipe) off the existing no-recipe ones, so both self-clear and stay frozen.

Leash auto-spec, not auto-all: the record schema addition is load-bearing and the fleet's mail path runs through the doorbell. The impl gate is self-asserted on the frozen suite; the landing is the owner's at the PR, which this unit never merges.

why.floor: none — additive only: 15 scenarios on unit/registry and 14 on mail/doorbell, zero lines removed from either frozen suite; both stay frozen. New scenarios narrow their Given (an owner with a home) off the no-home ones, which is specialization, not a contradiction, so no frozen Given was touched.
why.blast: medium — spec and suite only at this gate, two behavioral nodes plus prose cross-references in unit/lifecycle and agent. The doorbell node also gained the What, Control Flow and Scenario map sections it was missing, mapping its pre-existing scenarios.
why.novelty: medium — composes existing primitives (the presence lock, spawn into an existing folder, the trust step, the first-turn ring) but adds one new decision: a recorded folder consent that accepts a trust prompt a plain folder spawn leaves for a person.
why.confidence: high — three cold spec-judge rounds. Round 1 failed architect on that trust decision having no owner and contradicting the lifecycle prose; resolved by placing it in the doorbell and cross-referencing it. Rounds 2 and 3 aligned with all lenses passing; their content gaps were closed or recorded as follow-ups.
why.judge: cold sdd-spec-judge round 3 — oracle, builder, architect PASS; ALIGNED true; no failing scenario.
why.hitl: Self-asserted within the auto-spec leash. The landing is the owner's at the PR, which this unit never merges.
